mapper.insert: INSERT INTO amz_performance_ranking ( stat_month, principal_name, gross_profit, amount, refund_amount, create_time, update_time ) SELECT p.stat_month, COALESCE(NULLIF(pl.principal_name, ''), '未分配'), SUM(COALESCE(p.gross_profit, 0)), SUM(COALESCE(p.amount, 0)), SUM(COALESCE(p.refund_amount, 0)), NOW(), NOW() FROM amz_monthly_order_profit p JOIN amz_product_listing pl ON pl.asin = p.asin AND CAST(pl.sid AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.sid AND pl.seller_sku = p.seller_sku WHERE p.stat_month = #{statMonth} GROUP BY p.stat_month, COALESCE(NULLIF(pl.principal_name, ''), '未分配')
mapper.select:
SELECT id AS id, stat_month AS statMonth, principal_name AS principalNames, gross_profit AS grossProfit, amount AS amount, refund_amount AS refundAmount, update_time AS updateTime FROM amz_performance_ranking WHERE stat_month =

AND principal_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{principalName}, '%')
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC, amount DESC, id
